subject: Vendor onboarding: risk docs & PO next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@saturn-ml.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: docs we need to finish PO setup

Hi Elena —

Great to meet on the call last week. To get Saturn ML fully set up in our vendor system and to issue the first PO, Procurement needs a few items from your side:

- Completed vendor risk questionnaire (we attach our template as a reference below)
- COI showing general liability and cyber coverage, with Redwood Inference listed as additional insured (or certificate holder)
- W-9 or local tax equivalent
- Point of contact for invoicing and a sample invoice format (PDF)

If you can send the COI and W-9 this week we can start the PO creation. If there are any questions on coverage details or certificate language, Laura (cc'd) manages vendor onboarding and can confirm.

Quick ask: can you also confirm whether Saturn ML needs Redwood to complete an MSA/DocuSign prior to PO issuance, or if net-30 POs alone are sufficient?

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri﻿yom@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments (referenced): saturn_vendor-risk-questionnaire.docx (template)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@saturn-ml.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@saturn-ml.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: docs we need to finish PO setup

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear list. Sending the checklist items attached:

- Saturn_COI_2026.pdf (shows GL and cyber; Redwood Inference listed as certificate holder)
- Saturn_W9.pdf
- saturn_vendor-risk-questionnaire.docx (completed)

On the MSA: procurement@saturn-ml.com typically requires an executed MSA for engagements over $100k ARR, otherwise we accept a PO for the initial integration work. For this pilot scope we are fine with a PO + standard terms; I can route for signature if you prefer an executed agreement up front.

Please confirm receipt. If you need any edits to the COI wording (e.g., vicarious liability language), we can ask our broker to issue a revised certificate.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships, Saturn ML
elena@saturn-ml.com | +1 212-555-0199

Attachments: Saturn_COI_2026.pdf; Saturn_W9.pdf; saturn_vendor-risk-questionnaire.docx

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@saturn-ml.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: docs we need to finish PO setup

Laura / Marcus —

Forwarding Saturn's attachments. They provided a COI and W-9 and completed our risk questionnaire. Quick checklist for procurement/finance before I confirm PO:

- COI shows Redwood as certificate holder (it does); need to confirm limits match our minimums (see below)
- Verify cyber coverage and retro date language — Marcus, can you review the COI and confirm whether this satisfies our vendor cyber baseline?
- Confirm vendor tax id and W-9 are acceptable for vendor record creation
- Do we need a countersigned MSA for this initial PO? Elena says not required for pilot but can sign if we prefer.

COI highlights (from Saturn_COI_2026.pdf):
- General liability: $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate
- Cyber: $1M
- Redwood Inference listed as certificate holder (no additional insured endorsement included)

If procurement is comfortable issuing a PO without an additional insured endorsement, I'm happy to confirm next steps with Elena and request invoice routing details.

Thanks —
Priyom

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: docs we need to finish PO setup

Priyom / Laura —

Reviewed the COI and questionnaire. Quick summary:

- Cyber coverage at $1M meets our minimum for pilot/proof-of-concept work. Recommend accepting for initial PO.
- General liability limits are acceptable.
- COI lists Redwood as certificate holder but does not include an Additional Insured endorsement. For most SaaS integrations we accept the certificate holder status for pilots; for production deployments or customer-facing integrations we'll request Additional Insured.
- W-9 is valid and tax ID matches the vendor record.

Recommendation: proceed with PO issuance for the pilot. Log a requirement in the vendor record to obtain an Additional Insured endorsement before any production rollout.

Laura — can you create the vendor record and issue a standard PO (net-30) to Saturn ML? If you want, I can add the vendor risk notes to the file (short summary and the date to follow up for AI endorsement).

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
